title: Senior Program Manager - CDES
description:
Leidos’ Digital Sector is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the Cross Domain Enterprise Service (CDES) Engineering & Program Management Support program supporting the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA).

CDES supports a critical Department of Defense mission by delivering and sustaining secure enterprise information-sharing capabilities for DoD organizations and mission partners. Leidos provides an integrated team supporting program management, systems engineering, cybersecurity, technology development and implementation, customer engagement, deployment, and operational sustainment.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on, mission-focused leader who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and engaging directly with the customer, employees, technical leaders, business stakeholders, and mission partners. This position requires a leader who remains closely connected to program execution, develops a strong understanding of the technical and operational environment, identifies issues early, removes barriers, and maintains strong customer relationships.

The position is primarily located at Fort Meade, Maryland. Telework of up to approximately 25% may be available based on mission requirements, customer needs, team responsibilities, and program conditions. Travel is expected to be rare and primarily driven by specific mission or business requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Leidos Program Manager and primary customer interface, establishing and maintaining trusted relationships with DISA leadership, Government program personnel, mission stakeholders, and Leidos leadership.
  • Maintain overall responsibility for program execution, financial performance, schedule, staffing, technical delivery, quality, contractual performance, risk management, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide active, hands-on leadership across the program to ensure the team understands priorities, dependencies, risks, customer expectations, and required outcomes.
  • Maintain sufficient understanding of current program activities and technical initiatives to effectively represent the program, support informed decision-making, anticipate challenges, and drive successful execution.
  • Lead a multidisciplinary organization supporting areas such as program management, systems engineering, cybersecurity, technology integration, operational support, and customer requirements.
  • Partner closely with the customer to understand mission priorities, translate emerging requirements into executable plans, and align program resources to evolving needs.
  • Lead execution across the full technology lifecycle, including requirements definition, solution development, integration, testing, security authorization, implementation, deployment, operational transition, sustainment, modernization, and technology refresh.
  • Lead complex technology implementations involving multiple technical disciplines, Government organizations, external stakeholders, vendors, and mission partners.
  • Ensure technical teams apply sound engineering and technology-delivery fundamentals, including requirements management, architecture, interface management, systems integration, testing, cybersecurity, configuration management, operational readiness, and lifecycle sustainment.
  • Maintain integrated visibility across technical, programmatic, financial, staffing, customer, and schedule dependencies, ensuring issues and risks are identified and addressed before they affect mission delivery.
  • Manage program financial performance against the Annual Operating Plan, including revenue, operating income, margin, forecasting, Estimate at Completion, labor execution, and cost management.
  • Maintain disciplined program-management practices for schedule management, risk and opportunity management, staffing, quality, financial forecasting, contractual deliverables, and performance reporting.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of program managers, project managers, engineers, cybersecurity professionals, technical specialists, and support personnel.
  • Maintain direct engagement with employees and technical leaders to understand workload, priorities, morale, staffing needs, execution challenges, and professional-development opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and mission ownership.
  • Communicate program status, technical challenges, financial performance, risks, opportunities, and required decisions clearly to Government and Leidos leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement in program execution, customer experience, technical delivery, internal processes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Support proposal development, contract modifications, emerging requirements, and other opportunities for on-contract and adjacent growth.
  • Represent Leidos during customer meetings, program reviews, technical discussions, leadership engagements, and other program forums

Leadership Profile

  • The ideal candidate is a hands-on program leader who remains close to the customer, the people, and the work.
  • The Program Manager is expected to engage directly with technical teams, participate actively in customer discussions, understand current challenges, ask informed questions, make decisions, remove obstacles, and ensure commitments are delivered. Success requires balancing strategic leadership with active involvement in program execution.
  • The successful candidate should be equally comfortable discussing financial performance with Leidos leadership, mission priorities with the customer, technology implementation challenges with technical teams, workforce issues with employees, and program risks with senior stakeholders.
  • Most importantly, this individual must be able to build trust with both the customer and the team while creating the clarity, accountability, and focus necessary to successfully execute a complex and evolving mission.
  • This version keeps the mission recognizable to qualified candidates without exposing unnecessary detail about staffing, revenue, specific contractual tasking, deployment locations, or implementation specifics.

Basic Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years of relevant experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 4+ years of experience supervising or leading technical teams, programs, or projects.
  • Previous experience as a Program Manager, Deputy Program Manager, Task Order Manager, Project Manager, or equivalent delivery leader with direct accountability for program execution.
  • Demonstrated experience leading programs involving the full lifecycle development, implementation, integration, deployment, and sustainment of technology solutions.
  • Experience managing complex technical implementations involving multiple teams, stakeholders, vendors, dependencies, and customer organizations.
  • Strong understanding of systems and technology-delivery fundamentals, including requirements, architecture, engineering, integration, testing, cybersecurity, implementation, operations, and lifecycle support.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop sufficient understanding of complex technical environments to effectively lead teams, communicate with customers, identify risks, challenge assumptions, and support sound program decisions.
  • Experience managing the financial performance of Government contracts, including forecasting, budget management, labor execution, Estimate at Completion, revenue, operating income, and margin.
  • Proven ability to build strong customer relationships and operate effectively as a trusted partner to Government leadership.
  • Experience regularly communicating with senior Government and corporate leadership and presenting complex programmatic and technical information clearly and concisely.
  • Proven ability to lead diverse, high-performing teams across multiple technical disciplines and levels of experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities, evolving requirements, and significant customer interaction.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, negotiation, influence, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication capabilities.
  • Experience supporting proposals, contract modifications, new requirements, or other business-growth activities.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Candidate must possess an active DoD Secret security clearance and be eligible to obtain and maintain higher-level clearance and access requirements as needed by the mission.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active DoD Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance.
  • PMP certification or equivalent formal program/project-management credential.
  • Prior experience supporting DISA, DoD enterprise IT, Combatant Commands, Military Services, Defense Agencies, or other national-security customers.
  • Experience supporting secure or classified enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience with cross-domain technologies, cybersecurity, Risk Management Framework, Assessment & Authorization, or other DoD security processes.

While the program is not cloud-centric, a strong understanding of contemporary technology-development and implementation fundamentals is valuable.

title: Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate
description:
Make a real difference in patients’ lives—join Elevate Patient Financial Solutions as a Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate and help guide individuals through their healthcare financial journey. This full-time position is located 100% onsite at a hospital in {San Antonio, TX, with a Monday-Friday schedule from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.Rotating Weekends required
Bring your passion for helping others and grow with a company that values your impact. In 2024, our Advocates helped over 823,000 patients secure the Medicaid coverage they needed. Elevate’s mission is to make a difference. Are you ready to be the difference?
As a Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate, you play a vital role in guiding uninsured hospital patients through the complex landscape of medical and disability assistance. This onsite, hospital-based role places you at the heart of patient financial advocacy—meeting individuals face-to-face, right in their hospital rooms, to guide them through the process of identifying eligibility and applying for financial assistance. Your presence and empathy make a real difference during some of life’s most vulnerable moments.
Job Summary
The purpose of this position is to connect uninsured hospital patients to programs that will cover their medical expenses. As a Patient Advocate, you will play a critical role in assisting uninsured hospital patients by evaluating their eligibility for various federal, state, and county medical or disability assistance programs through bed-side visits and in-person interactions. Your primary objective will be to guide patients face-to-face through the application process, ensuring thorough completion and follow-up. This role is crucial in ensuring that uninsured patients are promptly identified and assisted, with the goal of meeting our benchmark that 98% of patients are screened at bedside. This position is responsible for working as the liaison between the patient in need, the hospital facility and government agencies, proficiently and effectively communicating in English and Spanish.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Screen uninsured hospital patients at bedside in an effort to determine if patient is a viable candidate for federal, state, and/or county medical or disability assistance.
  • Complete the appropriate applications and following through until approved.
  • Detailed, accurate and timely documentation in both MPower and the hospital systems on all cases worked.
  • Provide exceptional customer service at all times.
  • Participate in ongoing trainings in order to apply the content learned in dealings with patients and cases.
  • Maintain assigned work queue of patient accounts.
  • Collaborate in person and through verbal/written correspondence with hospital staff, case managers, social workers, financial counselors.
  • Answer incoming telephone calls, make out-bound calls, and track (via MPower) all paperwork necessary to submit enrollment and renewal for prospective Medicaid patients.
  • Maintain structured and timely contact with the applicant and responsible government agency, by phone whenever possible or as structured via the daily work queue.
  • Assist the applicant with gathering any additional reports or records, meeting appointment dates and times and arrange transportation if warranted.
  • Request home visits as needed to acquire documentation.
  • As per established protocols, inform the client in a timely manner of all approvals and denials of coverage.
  • Attend ongoing required training to remain informed about current rules and regulations related to governmental programs, and apply updated knowledge when working with patients and cases.
  • Regular and timely attendance.
  • All other duties as assigned
Qualifications and Requirements
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
  • High School Diploma or GED preferred, except when required by our client.
  • Prior hospital experience preferred
  • Adaptability when dealing with constantly changing processes, computer systems and government programs
  • Professional experience working with state and federal programs
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Ability to maneuver throughout the hospital and patients’ rooms throughout scheduled work shift.
  • Proficient experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel and Outlook
  • Effectively communicate both orally and written, to a variety of individuals utilizing fluent Spanish and English.
  • Ability to multitask to meet performance metrics while functioning in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hospital-Based Patient Advocates are expected to dress in accordance with their respective Client’s Dress Code.
  • Ability to multitask
  • Ability to function in a fast-paced environment
Benefits
ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well-being of our employees and their families.
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401K (100% match for the first 3% & 50% match for the next 2%)
  • 15 days of PTO
  • 7 paid Holidays
  • 2 Floating holidays
  • 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
  • Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles

title: Global Digital Asset Services Coordinator
description:

title: SCADA Engineer
description:
The SCADA Engineer will support the development and testing of advanced operational technology solutions for electric utility systems. This role will be part of a hands-on engineering environment focused on SCADA integration, real-time simulation, protection and automation, and the validation of emerging grid technologies. You will help ensure projects remain organized, on track, and aligned with established governance and delivery standards while adhering to Leidos' Mission, Vision, and Values.

Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

title: Software Engineer
description:
Leidos Defense is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team in our San Diego facility, supporting the U.S. Navy’s AN/SQQ-89(V) Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) systems.


Our program helps modernize Navy ships by replacing outdated sonar systems with updated AN/SQQ-89(V)15 systems, supporting the installation, logistics, quality checks, and training needed to prepare ship personnel to operate the new systems.


In this role, you will focus on modernizing the AN/SQQ-89(V) ASW Training System by transitioning Tactical Insertion (TI) hardware-based solutions to a scalable, virtualized Linux training platform. You’ll work with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), KVM, Open vSwitch, Python, Ansible, and hardware passthrough technologies to support complex Navy training and simulation environments.


What You'll Do

  • Design, deploy, and maintain virtualized environments supporting AN/SQQ-89(V)15 training capabilities.
  • Migrate software and services from Tactical Insertion hardware platforms to virtualized environments using KVM, libvirt, virsh, and VirtIO.
  • Build and maintain RHEL 7/8 system images, templates, and repositories.
  • Develop automated deployment and configuration solutions using Ansible.
  • Create Python utilities and scripts for system administration, testing, monitoring, and data management.
  • Configure and maintain Open vSwitch environments supporting multiple networks and high-throughput virtual machine communications.
  • Integrate physical and virtual networking within tactical training environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex virtualization, Linux, networking, storage, hardware, and application integration issues.
  • Support performance tuning and optimization of virtualized systems, networking, storage, and compute resources.
  • Support software integration, system verification, validation, and acceptance testing.
  • Collaborate with software developers, systems engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and training system stakeholders.
  • Support cybersecurity compliance activities, including STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, and RMF activities.
  • Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, deployment guides, standard operating procedures, and automation documentation.
  • Support modernization efforts focused on improving the portability, scalability, and maintainability of training environments.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 2–6 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience with Linux systems engineering, virtualization, software development, or platform engineering.
  • Experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.
  • Strong experience with KVM, libvirt, and virsh.
  • Experience implementing and troubleshooting Open vSwitch (OVS).
  • Experience with hardware passthrough technologies, including PCIe passthrough, VFIO, SR-IOV, and IOMMU configuration.
  • Experience developing infrastructure automation using Ansible.
  • Experience developing software and automation tools using Python.
  • Strong understanding of Linux networking concepts, including VLANs, bridges, routing, bonding, and virtual switching.
  • Experience troubleshooting integration issues across hardware, operating systems, networking, and applications.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AN/SQQ-89(V)15 or AEGIS combat systems.
  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
  • Experience with high-performance networking and low-latency virtualized environments.
  • Experience supporting GPU, FPGA, capture card, or other specialized hardware passthrough to virtual machines.
  • Familiarity with distributed storage, NFS, iSCSI, and SAN technologies.
  • Experience with FreeIPA, LDAP, Kerberos, and enterprise Linux identity management.
  • Experience supporting RMF, STIG implementation, ACAS, and cybersecurity compliance initiatives.

title: Senior Software Tester
description:
Position Summary

M&S Consulting is seeking a Senior Software Tester to serve as the senior individual contributor for platform and AI testing for the client's Blanket Purchase Agreement, where M&S is the Salesforce and Agentforce delivery partner under the prime contractor. This role designs and executes the test cases, evaluation transcripts, and scoring logic that validate the automated contact center solution on Salesforce, with a strong emphasis on the Agentforce / AI evaluation program under PWS 5.13.2.6. The Senior Software Tester works under the Software Testing Manager, partners closely with the Senior Software Developer / Manager and the developers, and helps calibrate the cross-clients functional testing team. This is a fully dedicated position within the M&S software delivery scope.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, document, and execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test cases for the Salesforce and Agentforce contact center solution.
  • Build and run AI evaluations under PWS 5.13.2.6, including test cases with complete transcripts and scoring logic, regression evals, faithfulness checks, benchmarking, LLM-as-a-Judge grading, and red teaming / adversarial testing to confirm outputs stay within configured guardrails.
  • Serve as a human-in-the-loop reviewer, scoring AI outputs to calibrate automated graders and validate accuracy, reliability, safety, and quality of AI-generated content.
  • Log, triage, and track defects to resolution; verify fixes; and maintain traceability from test cases to PWS requirements.
  • Validate Service Cloud, Service Cloud Voice, Open CTI, and integration behavior, including case creation, routing, and knowledge and content alignment.
  • Produce clear test documentation, evaluation results, and release evidence, and present findings to the Software Testing Manager and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with IT, Content, Operations, Quality, and Training stakeholders to support continuous improvement across the clients AI channels.
  • Support NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and FedRAMP Moderate-aligned test and release evidence.

Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • Minimum of three years of software testing, quality assurance, or Salesforce configuration / administration experience.
  • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist, current and in good standing, to support the AI evaluation and testing scope.
  • Demonstrated experience testing, evaluating, or monitoring Salesforce applications or AI / large language model outputs against defined criteria.
  • Certification level pre-approval ability to have any Salesforce or Agentforce certification level submitted to and approved by the client before performing any coding or configuration on the platform.
  • Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree, or equivalent relevant experience. Fields of information systems, business administration, or computer science are preferred.
  • Public Trust Low Risk suitability, or the ability to begin and complete the Public Trust Low Risk suitability process at award.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience testing and monitoring AI agents for continuous improvement, including federal Agentforce / agentic AI work.
  • Experience with an AI evaluation harness or framework and with LLM-as-a-Judge, faithfulness, and regression evaluation methods.
  • Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and case management at contact center scale, including Service Cloud Voice and Open CTI.
  • Salesforce administration or architecture depth, such as Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sharing and Visibility Architect, Data Architect, or Data Cloud.
  • Experience with service analytics, reporting, and dashboards for quality and performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with defect-tracking and CI/CD tooling such as Jira, Git, Salesforce DX, Copado, or Gearset.
  • Federal delivery aligned to NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and FedRAMP Moderate.

Engagement Details

  • Dedication fully dedicated to the client engagement.
  • Role designation software delivery support staff; not a PWS-named Key Personnel position.
  • Reporting reports to the Software Testing Manager and coordinates with the Senior Software Developer / Manager and development team.
  • Employer M&S Consulting.

title: PET/CT Technologist
description:
Why Join Us?

Beacon Clinic was founded for the purpose of delivering a level of care that we, as a team, can all be proud of. We are a patient-focused health and wellness clinic that is committed to providing the highest quality of medical care and supportive services. When founded, we specialized in the treatment of cancer and blood conditions. Today, we provide medical oncology and hematology, radiation oncology, rheumatology, and urology services to our phenomenal patients. Learn more about us at our website.

Job Description:

Join us at an exciting time as Beacon Clinic launches its brand-new outpatient PET/CT service line. This is a unique opportunity for motivated Technologists to play a key role in building the program from the ground up. As a valued member of our compassionate and collaborative community oncology team, you will help shape workflows, establish best practices, and deliver high-quality diagnostic imaging that supports comprehensive, patient-centered cancer care. Ideal candidates are confident problem-solvers, comfortable working independently, and eager to contribute to a service and team that will make a meaningful, lasting impact on the lives of our patients. *We will be looking to have a start date for this role in November/December 2026*

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Perform diagnostic CT and PET/CT imaging procedures with a high level of technical competence and patient care.

  • Perform diagnostic CT procedures to include injection of IV contrast or administration of oral contrast.

  • Demonstrates knowledge of contraindications and is able to recognize and appropriately respond to contrast reactions.

  • Prepare, administer, document, and safely dispose of radioactive isotopes in accordance with regulatory standards.

  • Apply radiation safety techniques to protect patients, staff, and self in compliance with ALARA principles.

  • Carry out complete imaging protocols including radiotracer administration, patient positioning, image acquisition, and data archiving.

  • Collaborate with front office and clinical teams to support procedure scheduling and ensure efficient daily workflow.

  • Maintain ACR accreditation standards and manage the ACR toolkit for compliance.

  • Accurately document patient demographics, manage image/report distribution, and maintain records in PACS/EMR systems.

  • Perform required daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) on PET/CT equipment in accordance with California and ACR guidelines.

  • Promptly report equipment malfunctions or radiation safety concerns to appropriate personnel, including the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO).

  • Assist in updating and maintaining imaging protocols and support implementation of software upgrades.

  • Monitor, track, and replenish medical supply inventory to ensure operational readiness.

  • Adhere to HIPAA regulations and uphold confidentiality of all protected health information (PHI).

  • Work closely with physicians, physicists, RSO, technologists and all care team members to ensure high imaging standards and exceptional patient care.

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental operations and patient care.

This list outlines the core responsibilities of the position but is not all-inclusive.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Graduate of an accredited Nuclear Medicine Technology program– Required

  • NMTCB (CNMT) or ARRT(N) certification, current and in good standing – Required

  • ARRT(CT) certification, current and in good standing – Required

  • BLS certification through AHA – Required

  • 1 year of PET/CT imaging experience - Required

  • Proficient in patient positioning, radiopharmaceutical preparation/administration, and basic equipment troubleshooting

  • Strong understanding of radiation safety practices, including ALARA principles and RAM license compliance

  • Knowledge of PET/CT imaging equipment operation and related safety protocols

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Experience in protocol development or launching new PET or CT imaging departments

  • Experience assisting with radiopharmaceutical therapy/theranostics administration

  • Prior use of (insert vendor GE/Siemens) imaging equipment

  • Familiarity with ACR accreditation standards and compliance processes

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

    Benefits:

      • Paid Time Off (PTO)

      • Eight (8) paid, closed clinic, holidays each year

      • Health insurance, including medical, dental, and vision

      • 401(k) plan

      • Professional development fund

      • Employee assistance program

      Shift: Full-Time Monday-Friday

      Beacon Company Mission: To meet patients wherever they are on their journey and walk with them on that journey; to provide compassionate, personalized healthcare for an unparalleled patient experience.

      Beacon Core Values: Compassion. Grace. Honesty. Humor. Respect. Trust.

      Our providers and staff at Beacon share these values and truly embody the mission of Beacon. Our team is comprised of the most devoted, compassionate individuals who consistently go above and beyond for patients and who strive to continually improve patient care and the overall patient experience.

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Senior Solutions Architect at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in collaborating with clients and internal teams to create advanced, transformational designs and architectural visions for complex solutions. Your expertise will drive the development of multi-technology consulting services that span application software, infrastructure, and related technology components.

You will contribute to complex solution architectures in specific business, infrastructure, or functional areas while evaluating alternative architectures for cost, performance, and scalability. By developing detailed specifications for cloud-based or on-premises components, you will ensure robust, cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' unique needs.

Your hands-on role will involve preparing technical plans and designs that comply with enterprise and solution architecture standards, remaining agile to adapt to changing project requirements. You will be accountable for understanding client requirements, collecting DATA, delivering thorough analysis, and providing effective problem resolution.

Keeping ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, you will produce insightful reports and technology roadmaps, sharing your knowledge with internal teams and clients alike. By creating multiple design views, you will address both functional and non-functional requirements, offering innovative solutions with proof-of-concept (POC) implementations. You will also mentor and guide less experienced colleagues, contributing to our collaborative culture.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • Advanced knowledge of multi-vendor service integrations and cross-functional software, operating systems, and infrastructure designs.
  • In-depth understanding of how specific infrastructures and application software are deployed in line with methodologies such as TOGAF, Zachman, SOA, ITIL, and COBIT.
  • Ability to develop and utilize advanced specialist knowledge of reference architectures.
  • Extensive experience in technical, IT, or operations roles within large-scale technology services environments.
  • Strong client engagement and consulting experience, including needs assessment and change management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams such as sales, product, and delivery.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • A continuous learning mindset to stay updated on trends and developments in technology domains.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a related field.

Workplace type:

Hybrid Working

About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Project Manager with a strong foundation in CRM and Customer Experience (CX) to lead the end-to-end delivery of high-impact, enterprise-scale initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders, technical teams, and executive leadership — ensuring every project is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to meaningful customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Program Delivery

  • Own the full project lifecycle for complex CRM and CX programs, from discovery and planning through to launch and post-go-live support.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project roadmaps, risk registers, and status reports that provide clear, data-driven visibility to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional dependencies proactively, minimizing disruption and keeping delivery on track.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and release coordination across multi-disciplinary Agile teams.

CRM & Customer Experience

  • Drive projects that enhance CRM platforms, customer data strategies, and omnichannel customer journeys.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure that technical solutions translate directly into improved customer outcomes.
  • Champion a CX-first mindset across all workstreams, bridging the gap between technology delivery and real-world business impact.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and executive sponsors, delivering clear escalation paths and proactive communication.
  • Manage relationships with internal teams, third-party vendors, and system integration partners.
  • Lead steering committees and governance reviews with confidence and executive presence.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of project management experience, with a strong focus on CRM and/or CX transformation initiatives.
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale projects in fast-paced, matrixed environments.
  • Solid command of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Exceptional skills in stakeholder communication, executive reporting, and risk management.
  • Strong understanding of CRM platforms, customer data models, and customer journey frameworks.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud) (a plus).
  • Proficiency in Jira for sprint management, epic/story tracking, and release coordination (a plus).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Confluence, Smartsheet, or Azure DevOps.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, or Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) certification.
  • Salesforce Administrator or Consultant certification is a bonus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven CRM capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce) is highly desirable.

title: Senior Energy Engineer
description:
Leidos Engineering LLC is a premier national engineering-based management consulting firm. We are seeking an experienced and motivated candidate to join our team as a Senior Energy Engineer. The position is ideal for a person with excellent technical skills and energy engineering experience with experience in calculating energy saving estimates, energy auditing, and communicating technical issues within the project team while working closely with contractors, suppliers, architects, and project engineers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Reviewing technical energy efficiency applications for incentives and rebates for Ameren Illinois electric and natural gas customers
  • Review different types of energy using systems within the industrial and/or commercial markets (HVAC, Lighting, compressed air systems, energy management systems, etc)
  • Research technology changes to support improvements to the energy efficiency program and provide solutions for implementation improvements
  • Maintain working knowledge of the Illinois Technical Reference Manual and associated energy efficiency concepts.
  • Review existing energy savings methods for quality control/improvements
  • Utilize independent judgment to verify technical requirements are met throughout various energy savings initiatives
  • Coordinate & provide guidance to supporting teams regarding energy efficiency programs

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Business Administration or related, with six plus (6+) years of relevant experience
  • Prior experience in energy efficiency or similar technologies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Products, especially Microsoft Excel
  • Must be able to work cooperatively on a technical team, along with working with non-technical team members.
  • Must have well developed communication skills and be able to express thoughts and ideas clearly and concisely in both verbal and written format.
  • Strong planning, organization, time management, and team-building skills with demonstrated ability to make unanticipated changes to production deliverables required

Preferred Qualifications

  • CEM or LEED certification
  • Understanding of utility-offered products or services
  • Focus on being able to see things through customer’s eyes to improve customer experience and satisfaction
  • Experience working with commercial contractors
  • Experience with Advanced Lighting and Controls, Commercial HVAC, Compressed Air, or Industrial Process technology
  • Familiarity with the International Energy Conservation Code (IECC) or ASHRAE Efficiency Standards
  • Experience with COMcheck, eQuest, Trane TRACE™, or Carrier HAP
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
  • Experience in the development and implementation of standards, procedures and guidelines for a process-oriented position.
  • Excellent English oral and written communication skills.

Job Location: This position is a remote position. Ameren Illinois and Leidos believe it is very important to provide employment opportunity to the utility ratepayers that reside in Illinois. Therefore, there is strong preference for the successful candidate to be located in the Ameren Illinois service territory https://www.ameren.com/illinois/company/about-ameren/service-territory (roughly the southern two-thirds of Illinois). The Ameren Illinois service territory includes several large to mid-size communities such as Galesburg, Quincy, Peoria, Bloomington-Normal, Champaign-Urbana, Danville, Decatur, Springfield, Charleston-Mattoon, Effingham, Mt. Vernon, Marion, Carbondale, and Metro East (Belleville, O'Fallon, Granite City, Edwardsville, Alton, Collinsville).

Travel may also be required to the Peoria, IL and/or Collinsville, IL offices on a periodic basis.


Although this role will primarily support the Ameren Illinois Energy Efficiency Program, Leidos will be the employer of the person, Ameren Illinois does not take any role in selecting the person for employment, and Ameren Illinois will not have any role in managing the work performed by the person.

  • 2-4 years of military or intelligence experience

title: Control Room Operator
description:
Careers at Keel

Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America.

At Keel, you’re not just joining a company, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute.

Why Keel

We’re at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time.

The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real.

You’ll be part of a team that values:

  • Ownership — we take responsibility and follow through
  • Collaboration — we work across teams, functions, and borders
  • Curiosity — we ask questions and keep learning
  • Endurance — we build for the long term

What It Feels Like to Work Here

  • Fast-moving, high-growth, and hands-on
  • Smart, driven people solving real challenges together
  • Work that directly supports AI and next-generation infrastructure
  • Room to grow, stretch, and take on more

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings with company contribution
  • Employee referral program

Interested? This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company!

GENERAL SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Shift Supervisor, and in coordination with the O&M services contract, performs the control room operation of main units and other plant equipment, and minor maintenance duties as required.

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS

  • Operates plant equipment and switchgear, which have their controls in the control room. Operates plant power units including starting up, paralleling and shutting down the main unit.
  • Places into service and removes from service various plant equipment and auxiliaries.
  • Well-versed in actions required to place plant equipment in a safe condition during emergency situations.
  • Performs, or assists in routine maintenance of equipment under his/her control; and performs in a maintenance mode when working his/her relief week (and not relieving other operators), for all overhauls, and other major maintenance-related downtimes.
  • Maintains station by way of consistent housekeeping and safety checks for potential safety hazards.
  • Assists, as required, in the training and orientation of new Control Room Operators, O&M Technicians, and Assistant Plant Operators.
  • Writes switching orders and performs necessary switching.
  • Must be available for overtime, rotating shifts, and emergency callouts.
  • Must be willing to work on a temporary basis as O&M Technician and/or Shift Supervisor.
  • Other tasks as assigned.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

Physical requirements include sitting, standing and walking. Occasional periods of lifting and climbing.

All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes a post-offer physical examination and drug screening and post employment random drug screening. There are extensive smoking restrictions in and around the facility.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum four (4) years experience in power plant operator functions, to include demonstrated experience in operating a power plant control room and all related auxiliary functions. High school diploma, or equivalent, required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of the principles of power production, control room operation, including knowledge of maintenance functions as relates to the control room, operating procedures, system operating orders, and clearance procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to clear equipment, write switching orders, and perform necessary switching.
  • Good communication skills.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (SCA/SAST)
description:
Senior Application Security Engineer (SCA/SAST)

Scale Security. Empower Engineers. Shape the Future.


Location: Canada-Remote


The Mission: At Trimble, we aren't just building software; we’re transforming the way the world works. We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer who is more than a technical expert—you are a strategist and a catalyst for secure innovation. You will lead the charge in open-source security (SCA) and static analysis (SAST) across a massive global footprint, ensuring that security is a seamless part of the developer experience.



Why This Role?

  • Global Influence: You won't just be "fixing bugs." You will be the architect of a global security strategy that impacts 99% of our engineering teams.
  • Strategic Autonomy: Lead the vision for our SCA and SAST roadmaps. You have the seat at the table to decide how we evolve.
  • Innovation at Scale: Work across diverse tech stacks—from .NET and Java to Go and Python—integrating security directly into the heartbeat of our CI/CD pipelines.


How You’ll Make an Impact

Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the global SME for SCA and SAST, turning complex security requirements into scalable, automated solutions.
  • Optimize our security tooling to be "developer-first," slashing false positives and focusing engineering energy on what truly matters.
  • Shape the organizational approach to open-source security and license compliance.

Engineering Excellence

  • Embed security into the DNA of the SDLC by collaborating with architects and product owners worldwide.
  • Automate everything. You’ll build the "guardrails" that allow our developers to move fast without breaking things.
  • Mentor the next generation of security talent and lead through influence across cross-functional teams.

Vision & Advisory

  • Stay ahead of the curve. You’ll evaluate emerging security tech and proactively keep Trimble at the cutting edge.
  • Conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews to kill vulnerabilities before they are ever coded.


The Profile We’re Looking For

  • The Architect: 5+ years in AppSec with a deep, battle-tested mastery of SCA and SAST implementation at an enterprise level.
  • The Polyglot: You speak the language of developers. Whether it’s Java, C#, Python, or Go, you can read the code and provide real remediation paths.
  • The Integrator: You live in the pipeline. You have hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
  • The Communicator: You can translate "security risk" into "business value" for stakeholders and "clear action" for engineers.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: People Shared Services Specialists I (remote eligible)
description:
Position Summary

The People Shared Services Specialist I serves as a first point of contact for associates and corporate employees seeking support with People-related questions, Workday transactions, policies, programs, and services.

This role manages a high volume of cases through Workday and other approved service channels. The Specialist delivers timely, accurate, professional, and empathetic support; resolves inquiries within established scope; documents actions clearly; and escalates complex, sensitive, or out-of-scope matters to the appropriate Tier 2 or Center of Excellence (COE) teams.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, detail-oriented, comfortable using technology, and able to balance productivity, accuracy, confidentiality, and quality in a fast-paced service environment. This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping others navigate People processes, and contributing to a positive associate experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, research, respond to, and resolve associate and employee inquiries through Workday Help Case Management and/or other approved support channels.

  • Manage a high-volume case queue while prioritizing work based on urgency, business impact, service-level commitments, and established procedures.

  • Provide clear, accurate, professional, and customer-focused written responses that address the individual’s question and explain next steps when applicable.

  • Apply established policies, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, process documentation, and system resources to resolve inquiries accurately and consistently.

  • Complete permitted Workday transactions and support requests within the role’s defined scope, following established controls and approval requirements.

  • Take ownership of cases from intake through resolution whenever possible, ensuring appropriate follow-up and a positive support experience.

  • Identify when an inquiry requires escalation because of complexity, sensitivity, risk, policy interpretation, system issues, or work outside the Specialist’s authorized scope.

  • Escalate cases to the appropriate Tier 2, COE, HRIS, Absence/Benefits, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, or other teams in accordance with defined escalation procedures.

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely case documentation, including the issue, research performed, actions taken, information provided, disposition, and escalation details.

  • Protect confidential associates, employees, and company information in accordance with company policies, privacy requirements, and data handling standards.

  • Meet established performance expectations related to case quality, productivity, response time, resolution time, schedule adherence, customer experience, and service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, team meetings, quality reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities to build proficiency in People processes, Workday functionality, and support tools.

  • Help to identify recurring questions, unclear processes, knowledge gaps, system issues, or opportunities to improve self-service and share observations with leadership.

  • Demonstrate flexibility as People processes, Workday functionality, business priorities, organizational structures, and service-delivery needs evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 1+ years’ experience using Workday & Workday Help Case Management.

  • 1+ years of experience in customer service, contact center operations, shared services, case management, help desk support, administrative support, retail operations, hospitality, HR support, or another high-volume service environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and respectfully with individuals at all levels of the organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail, responsiveness, and accuracy.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to research available information, follow established processes, use sound judgment, and recognize when escalation is needed.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a case queue and follow through on commitments.

  • Proficiency with common business applications, including Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and comfort learning new systems and technology.

  • A positive, helpful, and customer-focused approach, with the ability to demonstrate empathy and professionalism in every interaction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting HR, People Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Leave, Talent Acquisition, or employee relations processes.

  • Experience in a large, distributed, retail, hospitality, call-center, or multi-location organization.

  • Experience supporting associates or employees through phone, email, chat, case management, or other digital service channels.

  • Familiarity with service-level agreements, customer-service metrics, quality standards, or knowledge-management practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful People Shared Services Specialist I:

  • Delivers fast, accurate, and high-quality support that makes People processes easier for associates and employees to navigate.

  • Consistently meets established service level, productivity, quality, and case-management expectations.

  • Takes ownership of inquiries and resolves them at the first point of contact whenever possible.

  • Use established policies, procedures, knowledge resources, and Workday tools to provide consistent answers and complete appropriate transactions.

  • Communicates with clarity, empathy, professionalism, and respect, particularly when an associate is frustrated or unsure of next steps.

  • Demonstrates sound judgment by resolving matters within scope and escalating issues promptly and accurately when needed.

  • Maintains thorough, timely, and audit-ready case documentation.

  • Protects confidential information and follows company policies, controls, and procedures.

  • Quick learner adapting to changing processes and technology, and applies feedback from coaching and performance and Quality reviews.

  • Contributes to a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and exceptional associate service.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
Join a team committed to a mission!

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Are you ready for your next career challenge?

The Defense Sector of Leidos has a career opportunity for a talented Quality Control Lead to support several programs in the Non-Kinetics Business Area in Alburquerque, NM. This position serves as a member of a team with the responsibility to ensure quality service is provided to customers through the generation of a Quality Management System, control of program processes, and record/report metrics.

This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining technical quality assurance and control systems to prevent defects in delivered products. Duties may include defining and implementing standards, methods, and procedures for inspecting, and evaluating the precision, accuracy, and reliability of client and/or company products. Using existing or developed systems, identifies failure trends and verifies consistency of design standards throughout the entire product lifecycle, from design through delivery. Analyzes post-delivery reports and feedback for trends and recommends actions to correct procedural, product, or process deficiencies. Works to achieve day-to-day objectives with moderate impact on the area/ project team. Works independently on larger, moderately complex projects/assignments. May assist other technical staff with tasks and assignments. Addresses somewhat complex technical issues/problems using internal best practice and through collaboration with colleagues. Develops solutions to technical problems that require depth of technical knowledge but are typically limited in complexity. Communicate with colleagues across multiple areas (project managers, other technical resources, etc.). Explain technical solutions, practices and procedures to others within the organization. Requires working knowledge of and ability to apply standards, principles, theories, concepts, and techniques of technical domain.

Primary Responsibilities:

Assist in Planning and Documenting the Receipt & Shipping Inspections, document & control any non-conformities, inspections of material to verify conformance to requirements. Review shipping requirements for accuracy, completeness, authorization, destination, special handling/labeling requirements.   • Collaborate with program teams to design, implement, and execute a QMS

  • Review supplier inspection and test documentation, including First Article Inspections (FAIs), source inspection records, material certifications, and test reports.
  • Apply lessons learned, performance data, and industry best practices across programs to drive improvement and prevent recurring issues.

Reporting, Communications, and Escalation:

  • Provide the PM with regular briefings (performance metrics performance, inspection reports, continuous improvement project status and achievements) to support situational awareness and execution reporting
  • Support Leidos reporting, such as Quality Management Reviews, In Process Reviews, Weekly Activity Reports, and Monthly Operational Reviews

General:

  • Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment,

  • Minimum of 12 years of networking or IT security experience

title: Offensive Operational Planner, Senior
description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. The Leidos Intel Sector combines technology-enabled services and mission software capabilities in the areas of cyber, logistics, security operations, and decision analytics to support our defense and intel customers’ mission to defend against evolving threats around the world.

Your greatest work is ahead!

The Intel Sector seeks highly qualified and trained Senior-level Offensive Cyberspace Operational Planners to support Department of Defense Joint Planning processes that underpin United States Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM) operations, with focus on supporting power projection in and through cyberspace in support of Combatant Commander and National objectives. Individuals will engage in Cyberspace Operational Planning activities supporting Leidos on-site contract support to USCYBERCOM J3 (Operations), Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF), and Joint Task Force-Ares (JTF-ARES).

This opportunity is in anticipation of a potential future contract award!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead plans development and staffing processes within collaborative environment to drive range of Cyberspace Operations (CO) according to USCYBERCOM planning guidance and applicable Joint publications.

  • Lead development and synchronization of Offensive Cyberspace Operational (OCO) plans to deliver integrated cyber effects against adversary systems in support of Joint and National strategic objectives.

  • Focus on supporting OCO through effective, timely, and relevant Joint planning support.

  • Drive integration and coordination of OCO and Defensive Cyberspace Operations (DCO) planning processes

  • Drive targeting selection, validation, synchronization, and enable integration during the execution of activities within Cyber Warfare domain.

  • Lead drafting and staffing of foundational planning documents such as Operational Plans (OPLANS), Operational Orders (OPORDs), and Fragmentary Orders (FRAGOs).

  • Support and lead, as appropriate, Joint Operational Planning Groups and Teams (OPG/OPT), and develop and integrate Cyberspace capabilities into plans.

  • Develop concepts of support, courses of action, integrate command and external capabilities, coordinate and document comprehensive plans.

  • Engage in, and provide situational awareness to, range of projects, Crisis Action Teams, and current operations activities supporting OPTs.

  • Demonstrate deep knowledge of cyber threats and attack methods and techniques emanating from state and non-state adversaries and tiered vulnerabilities within Blue Space as focus of threats.

  • Review, approve, prioritize, and submit operational requirements for research, development, and/or acquisition of cyber capabilities and develop and maintain deliberate and/or CO crisis plans.

  • Integrate and synchronize intelligence planning activities with operational planning timelines.

  • Conduct long-range, strategic planning efforts with internal and external partners in cyber activities.

  • Communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Active Top Secret/SCI (TS/SCI) security clearance with Polygraph is required for consideration.

  • BA/BS degree within Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or field of study

  • Eight plus years recent (since 2015) work experience as CO Planner: can waive two years of experience requirement for every year spent on a Combat Mission Team (CMT) in any work role.

  • Demonstrated familiarity with OCO concepts, capabilities, and authorities (Title 10 vs. Title 50, and familiarity with military operations including phases of planning, approval, and execution and mastery of applicable Joint Publications.

  • Formal training as Cyber Operational Planner within Department of Defense or Intelligence Community.

  • Senior-level knowledge of Blue-space Cyber capabilities and demonstrate understanding of available Cyber infrastructure or platforms to conduct OCO.

  • Knowledge of the range of CO and their underlying intelligence support needs, topics, and focus areas.

  • Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as well as concepts, terminology, and operations of a wide range of communications media (computer and telephone networks, satellite, fiber, wireless).

  • Ability to support timely, accurate, relevant analytical production, to include documents, summaries, issue papers, talking points, and briefings.

  • Demonstrated proficiency working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, ability to proactively multi-task and meet short deadlines.

  • Strong interpersonal, critical thinking, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex and technical data to nontechnical consumers.

  • Able to work across Department of Defense and Intelligence Community agencies to support organizational goals.

Favorable if you have:

  • Masters’ Degree within Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or relevant field of study

  • Deep understanding of USCYBERCOM organizational structure and mission.

  • Extensive experience supporting Joint operations across multiple warfighting domains.

  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning into operations at any level to increase efficiency and effectiveness of operational outcomes

  • Experience with Space-enabled CO

  • Joint Professional Military Education, Phase II (JPME II) graduate, or civilian equivalency.

  • Formal training within field of Cyber Warfare and Joint Operations.

  • Completion of Service-specific or Joint Cyberspace Operational Planning courses, such as Army Cyberspace Operations Planners Course or Joint Cyberspace Operations Planners Course.

  • Demonstrated experience with development and delivery of CO-related training and support to exercise planning and execution at any level.

  • Familiar with art of Data Science and applicability to CO.

  • Familiar with Microsoft Power BI data visualization software.

  • Desired Certifications: DoD 8570 IAT Level II (CCNA Security, COMPTIA CySA+, COMPTIA Security + CE, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP).

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Senior Cloud Technical Architect at NTT DATA, you'll utilize your advanced expertise to design and potentially implement sophisticated cloud-based solutions that fulfil our clients' technical and business requirements. In this role, you'll support our sales teams by providing deep knowledge of cloud computing technologies, ensuring that our solutions are designed, deployed, and operated to meet client needs effectively.

You will collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and convert them into scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions. Your day-to-day Responsibilities will involve acting as a trusted technical advisor to our clients, designing and architecting cloud systems that ensure high availability, scalability, performance, and reliability.

You'll design integration solutions to enable seamless DATA flow between cloud and on-premises environments, and you'll define and implement security best practices and compliance standards for cloud systems.

You'll work closely with development teams to ensure adherence to cloud architecture standards, develop technical design documents, and participate in scope-of-work determinations, product pricing, and RFP/RFI responses. Your expertise will drive client proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives and ensure the successful transition of proposed solutions to our delivery team.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in both machine learning and deep learning.   • Implement and fine-tune pre-trained AI models tailored to meet specific industry needs.

  • Apply techniques to reduce AI hallucination and enhance model reliability.
  • Utilize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques to improve AI response quality.
  • Work with vector databases, specifically PostgreSQL with pgvector, for efficient similarity search and information retrieval in AI applications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to seamlessly integrate AI capabilities into our products and services.
  • Engage in prompt engineering to enhance model interaction and output quality.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in AI technologies, contributing to the adoption of new tools and techniques.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.

  • In-depth knowledge of AWS data services, including Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, and their application in AI/ML pipelines.
  • Expertise in Agentic Behavior in AI and deploying models using technologies like CrewAI, LangGraph, and Langchain.
  • Experience with vector databases and similarity search techniques for scalable AI solutions.
  • Understanding of AI/ML algorithms and architectures, including CNNs, RNNs, transformers, and experience building end-to-end solutions.
  • Expertise in data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead AI/ML projects and communicate complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Good to Have:
  • Experience implementing or integrating Amazon Connect with AWS AI Services to deliver intelligent customer engagement solutions.
  • Knowledge of big data technologies such as Apache Spark or Hadoop.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques.
Highly Desirable:
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Generative AI Developer- Professional, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Associate, AWS Certified AI Practitioner).

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.

Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.

You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.

Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
  • Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
  • Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
  • Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
  • Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
  • Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
  • A client-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
  • Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
  • Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
  • A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
  • Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

Workplace type:

Hybrid Working
