title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).

Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.

You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.

As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.

You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.

Hybrid Working

title: Senior AI Customer Engineer
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
We are looking for a Senior AI Customer Engineer to help enterprise customers successfully deploy, integrate, and optimize AI-powered solutions at scale. In this role, you will work closely with customers, engineering teams, and cloud platforms to troubleshoot complex technical issues, drive successful AI adoption, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.


Key Responsibilities

AI & Enterprise Platform Support

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to enterprise integrations and third-party platforms, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications.
  • Support customers in designing, deploying, and operating Agentic AI solutions and AI-driven workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve issues across AI/ML services, APIs, authentication layers, networking components, and cloud platforms.
  • Analyze model behavior, data quality, schema validation, and ML lifecycle processes to identify and address performance challenges.
  • Advise customers on AI cost optimization strategies, including compute, storage, training, and inference efficiency.
  • Apply security, privacy, and governance best practices to ensure compliance and responsible AI adoption.

Security, Identity & Networking

  • Troubleshoot and support enterprise identity and access management solutions, including: OAuth 2.0 SAML / OIDC SCIM RBAC Identity Federation Permission Mapping
  • Diagnose connectivity and infrastructure issues across cloud environments, including: VPC/VNet DNS Firewalls VPNs Load Balancers Private Endpoints

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Manage and troubleshoot solutions running on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Support AI/ML services such as Azure AI, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or similar platforms.
  • Work with Kubernetes and containerized environments to maintain reliable, production-grade systems.
  • Leverage monitoring and observability tools to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues.

Data & Automation

  • Build, maintain, or troubleshoot ETL pipelines, data platforms, and AI/ML orchestration workflows.
  • Support automation initiatives that improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Technical Support, AI Solutions, Customer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Strong understanding of Agentic AI concepts and frameworks, including: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication Tool Calling Workflow Orchestration AI Agent Architectures
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS platforms, APIs, networking, and identity management.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML lifecycle processes and production support best practices.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Experience

  • Background as a Customer Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers and mission-critical production environments.
  • Exposure to Generative AI, AI Agents, cloud-native technologies, and enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
